slice: PL Cloud and Hosted Services Platform

capabilities.name: Cloud Provider Abstraction
capabilities.description: Route identity, database, storage, sync, backup, compute, AI, rendering, builds, collaboration, marketplace, and notifications through capability-based providers.
capabilities.source: v1.19 — Wave 1.19.1 Cloud provider abstraction and service routing
capabilities.notes: Cloud-disabled, local, self-hosted, PL Cloud, and approved third-party modes remain first-class.

capabilities.name: Identity Accounts and Device Linking
capabilities.description: Provide optional accounts, profiles, sessions, secure tokens, recovery, deletion, privacy controls, trusted devices, and account synchronization.
capabilities.source: v1.19 — Wave 1.19.2 Identity accounts local-only mode and device linking
capabilities.notes: Supabase is the approved initial account/auth foundation; accounts remain optional for local use.

capabilities.name: Project Sync Backup and Object Storage
capabilities.description: Provide project sync, backup sets, snapshots, storage, resume, integrity checking, selective sync, restore, transfer accounting, and conflict entry points.
capabilities.source: v1.19 — Wave 1.19.3 Sync backups object storage and conflict-safe transfer
capabilities.notes: Cloudflare R2 is the approved initial object-storage backend.

capabilities.name: Owned and Subscription Entitlements
capabilities.description: Synchronize owned extension and pack entitlements while keeping them structurally separate from subscription service entitlements.
capabilities.source: v1.19 — Wave 1.19.4 Ownership licensing entitlements and offline cache
capabilities.notes: Owned local products retain permanent offline use and cannot depend on continuous verification.

capabilities.name: Subscriptions Billing Credits and Usage
capabilities.description: Provide billing, plans, invoices, cancellation, entitlement updates, usage accounting, limits, credits, warnings, support tools, and cost monitoring.
capabilities.source: v1.19 — Wave 1.19.5 Subscriptions credits billing usage and plan limits
capabilities.notes: Stripe is the approved billing foundation.

capabilities.name: Self-Hosting and Custom Endpoints
capabilities.description: Provide custom endpoints, health checks, credentials, certificates, homelab routing, capability detection, diagnostics, migration, and export.
capabilities.source: v1.19 — Wave 1.19.6 Self-hosting homelab routing and custom endpoints
capabilities.notes: Provider differences must be exposed rather than falsely presenting every backend as identical.

capabilities.name: Hosted Compute AI Render and Build Services
capabilities.description: Provide optional hosted AI, remote compute, rendering, conversion, builds, backup, and workflow execution with estimates, limits, queues, costs, logs, cancellation, and local fallback.
capabilities.source: v1.19 — Wave 1.19.7 Hosted AI cloud compute rendering builds and orchestration
capabilities.notes: Uploads require explicit context and provider consent.

capabilities.name: Online Marketplace Commercial Backend
capabilities.description: Provide online catalogs, search, listings, checkout, entitlements, signed downloads, updates, ownership recovery, subscription listings, analytics, and commercial first-party products.
capabilities.source: v1.19 — Wave 1.19.8 Online marketplace backend and commercial operation
capabilities.notes: Purchase, restore, refund, offline use, update, rollback, and account deletion scenarios require validation.

capabilities.name: Cloud-Optional Product Boundary
capabilities.description: Guarantee that local projects, local AI, local workflows, local engines, and owned local extensions remain usable when cloud services are disabled or unavailable.
capabilities.source: v1.19 — Validation and public-beta release gate
